head: Face Witness face maker app lets you build a face piece by piece
dek: Face Witness is a new 99-cent iPhone app for building a face from separate parts: you pick eyes, a nose, a mouth, hair and other details, then move and resize each one. It was #4 in paid Entertainment apps on the US App Store on 15 November.
details: You can undo changes, adjust each feature and save the finished picture to Files or share it. Projects stay on the iPhone, so you can come back to them later, and no account is needed. It came out on 6 November and is made by Denis Michkarev.
means: If you like making funny faces or sketching a face from memory, this is a cheap way to do it on your phone.
todo: Get it from the App Store; it's a one-time 99-cent purchase with no account.
thumb_words: BUILD A FACE PIECE BY PIECE
